title: Ghillie's Monsters Break Torches
description: A Minecraft datapack that allows hostile mobs to break torches and extinguish campfires
body:
Hostile Mob Torch Breaker Datapack

This datapack introduces a new ability for hostile mobs, allowing them to break torches and extinguish campfires. It was designed to enhance the challenge of my hardcore survival modpack.

Features:
1.Hostile Mobs Affected:
- Zombie
- Husk
- Skeleton
- Stray
- Drowned
- Zombified Piglin

2.Behavior:
- Every 10 seconds, the datapack choses 3 random entities of each type from the list above.
- It searches for torches and campfires within a 3x3x3 block cube around each chosen entity.

3.Torch Breaking and Campfire Extinguishing:
- Torches drop as items when destroyed.
- A distinct sound plays when a torch is broken or a campfire is put out.

Important Notes:
1. This datapack simply replaces nearby blocks around zombies, without adding any custom animations or modifying AI behavior.
2. In the future, I plan to add configuration options for:
- Adding new mobs to the list.
- Changing the chance of torch destruction.
- Disabling specific features.
